title: City Council Meeting
motion: approve Resolution 2020-12 subject to the following changes to the Agreement: 1. Section 3(H) relating to non-funding. At the end of the fifth line revise the sentence to read: “Procurer’s obligation to contribute TRCC funds to the City, under this Agreement, beyond that date will be null and void, unless the City has entered a contract for the art piece contemplated and a portion of the allocated funds have been expended.” 2. Section 3(H) add language at the end of the sentence to read, “.. beyond fiscal year 2021.” 3. Delete subsection 3.I.iii entitled “Termination Prior to Disbursement” in its entirety
result: Resolution 2020-12 was approved by a unanimous vote.
